events.title: SRPP Threads and Posts Junked
events.description: Omniscient revisited the SRPP section change from a few months back. With current world events, they say it would have flooded the section — confirming approximately 36,000 threads and 900,000 posts have officially been junked, affecting some members' post and thread counts.

events.title: Monetary Contests Rule
events.description: After a wave of fake giveaways in the Member Contests section, Omniscient now requires hosts of monetary giveaways to send the prize amount to him to hold until the contest ends — making sure giveaways are legitimate.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Green Apple awarded to Bodega, MMDesigns, and Nightmare. Quickly Loved awarded to MMDesigns. Businessman awarded to FireBender. King Decade awarded to GoldOne and ???. 24k awarded to The Pact.

events.title: Stuff You Do That Feels Wrong (But Isn't!)
events.description: R5N3T asked about completely legal moments that still trigger guilt — walking out of a store empty-handed, using a bathroom without buying anything, refusing to share personal info for a 'promotion' — turning into a casual relatable thread.

events.title: Perplexity Pro recommended LSD for Panic / Covid?
events.description: Rsynced shared a concerning example of Perplexity surfacing drug suggestions in response to anxiety and long-COVID-adjacent conversation, sparking a discussion about memory, context bleed, and how badly recommendation systems can misread vulnerable users.

events.title: Do you check your phone the moment you wake up?
events.description: Omega Sapien's question about morning phone-checking sparked discussion about doomscrolling, emails, self-control, and the dependency many people have built on the first screen of the day.

events.title: Tips to Deal with a Teen Who's Too Focused on Their Phone?
events.description: R5N3T asked for advice on his 13-year-old daughter's phone use — replies covered hobbies, sports, gradual limits, device swaps, and understanding what the phone was actually being used for.

events.title: Pronounceable Passphrase Generator
events.description: Immortal shared a Python passphrase generator that balances strong entropy with usability, producing passwords that are far easier to read and type than random-character soup.

events.title: $50 Crypto Contest - LTC
events.description: SoulZeh is hosting a $50 LTC giveaway under The Brotherhood banner — entry requires a post, rep, and at least six months of site membership. Ends March 31.

events.title: $200 Crypto Giveaway - Crack The Seed Part 3
events.description: 7 launched a puzzle-style $200 SOL giveaway: contestants must crack a 12-word mnemonic to access the wallet. Hints are revealed in the thread.

events.title: Movie of the Week — Irreversible (2002)
events.description: Hackers submitted Irreversible — calling it intense with a heavy mix of anxiety and violence, and definitely not a film for kids.
